hints.title: Priority Expansion over Sorted Coordinates
hints.text: The pair with the smallest sum is nums1[0] plus nums2[0]. Successors are created by incrementing indices.

hints.title: Initial Seed Index Strategy
hints.text: Push initial pairs (nums1[i] + nums2[0], i, 0) for each i up to min(k, len(nums1)). When popping a pair, only the next element in nums2 needs to be considered.

hints.title: Successor Advancement Step
hints.text: Pop the minimal pair (i, j) from the priority container and record it. If j plus one is within nums2 bounds, push (nums1[i] + nums2[j+1], i, j+1). Repeat until k pairs are gathered or container is empty.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(K log(min(K, N1))) time and O(min(K, N1)) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all N1 * N2 pairs and sorting takes O(N1 * N2 log(N1 * N2)) time and excessive memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains at most min(K, N1) elements in the priority structure, generating only the optimal K pairs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should avoid inserting duplicate pairs by advancing only one dimension (j) after seeding with index 0.
